dogecoin.text: Coinbase $COIN went public this week with a direct listing of its shares on Nasdaq, is missing out on the latest frenzy whipping up gasps and chortles in digital asset markets: a ferocious rally in dogecoin #DOGE to more than 6,000% for the year to date.
#Dogecoin was worth as much as $55 billion on Friday, nearly tripling on the day. At current levels, it’s worth about as much as $F Ford and Marriott $MAR
